title: Part I: logo skip, intro, kitchen, circus, petal, map, chicken, Otis, store with Credit Early, mansion, Fester and the underwater idol, forest (map teleport) and the treasure

entry.notes: Boot of the DOS CD release in ScummVM 2026.3.0 with the bridge; the run clock starts at the first move (the logo-skip Esc, SPEEDRUN_START_FRAME). SPEEDRUN_SKIP_TEXT and SPEEDRUN_SKIP_CUTSCENES are on from that Esc: every '.' and every Esc not listed as a move is the bridge's automatic skip, pressed on the first frame a line can be cut or an override is armed; move notes say which overrides each move passes through. The brief says control first comes at the Lookout: on DOS CD the Lookout has input on but no verb bar and must not be clicked; usable control starts on the dock 0.42 s after the logo Esc (docs/anypercent/findings.md). Money starts at 0 (Var[195]; room-038-lookout/entry.txt [002C]-[0040]). Map entries are counted in Var[290] (0 at boot). Interleave points for S2 (fish, sword, troll, Smirk, fights) are marked 'S2 HANDOFF' in move notes; this file contains only S1 moves. Script logic was checked against data/scripts-dos-cd: the route rooms differ from Mac only in sound and resource calls (plus the CD-only wait for sound 108 on the Lookout stairs and two extra fish scripts underwater), so the engine-verified glitchless model's ids and mechanics carry over. REVISION NOTES: S2 cites S1 moves by 1-based position; this revision keeps all 96 positions. The only reorder is the kitchen pair: position 9 is now the pot and position 10 the meat (the record's order, after S2's fish). The file encodes the MERGED run (S1 + S2 interleaved). The moves that differ when S1 runs alone are the two kitchen pickups and the helmet move (their notes give the standalone form). S2 owns the shop's 'browse' choice and the walk from the treasure room back to the map.

A v5 leg that ends on its target continues with a full step of the next leg in the same frame, so ego is never seen on (215,118). At the decision point (where the bridge checks `until`) he is last in box 5 at 223 minus one step (218 for the replay's 5 px step), then in box 7 at 215 minus one step (the replay's (210,117)). Local 202 STOPs at the start of that frame. So the stop is always at x 207-214, never above 216, and above 200, so it always happens. The bound 216 is safe for any step size. It holds either at the last box-5 position (only if that is 216, a 7 px step), and then #17's click lands on the STOP frame and wins, or in box 7 after the STOP. Do NOT loosen it (a reviewer suggested 224): box-6 positions start at 224, and a click two frames before box 7 is cancelled by the STOP, so #17 would stall. With the real 5 px step, the cost is one standing frame. 218 would save that frame (see open_questions). C3 cannot test walkboxes.

Engine error (crash): ScummVM's startScene() calls error() if the current script is a room, object or local script with an active cutscene override when a room change happens (third_party/scummvm/engines/scumm/room.cpp startScene). No S1 move does this; keep it in mind for any reordered input.

Engine error (crash): stopping a global or local script, or an object script, while it is inside cutscene()..endCutscene() calls error() in v5 ('Script %d stopped with active cutscene/override' / 'Object %d stopped with ...', third_party/scummvm/engines/scumm/script.cpp:271-275 and 305-309; cutscene() is what counts, script.cpp:1634). A non-recursive startScript stops the running instance first (script.cpp:65-66), and setOwnerOf(x,0) stops x's object script first (object.cpp:180, clearOwnerOf -> stopObjectScript). So never re-trigger a local or object script while it is inside its cutscene (store local 202, bar local 214, poodles local 201, jail local 203), and never move a setOwnerOf(x,0) into x's own running verb script. On this route every such cutscene turns input off (global/script-018.txt [0005]-[0007]), so only reordered or injected input can hit this.

'Use meat with flower' was a famous ScummVM crash (bug #2771): an inventory object's own script removing an object. ScummVM 2026.3.0 raises error() only in two 'odd setOwnerOf' cases, and both need the CURRENT script to be the inventory object's script (third_party/scummvm/engines/scumm/object.cpp setOwnerOf, 158-169). The drug move ('Use meat with petal') runs the meat's verb script, which removes the petal from inside global script 182 (global/script-182.txt [0017]), so the current script is a global and neither case applies. The record's 'Use petal with meat' reaches the same code after one re-send. Do not route any item removal through a different verb path without checking this.
